MiniSat upstream: commit 37dc6c67e2af26379d88ce349eb9c4c6160e8543.

Local changes needed for a C++17 core-library build on Windows, with no
compressed-DIMACS input support and no zlib dependency:

1. minisat/utils/ParseUtils.h: MINISAT_NO_ZLIB conditionally excludes the
   zlib header, StreamBuffer class, and its isEof overload. String parsing
   used by Options.h remains available. Compile with MINISAT_NO_ZLIB.
2. minisat/utils/System.cc: give non-Linux memUsedPeak implementations the
   bool argument already declared in System.h.
3. minisat/core/Solver.cc and minisat/utils/Options.h: add whitespace around
   PRIu64 / PRIi64 format macros, required for standard C++11 and later.
4. minisat/core/SolverTypes.h: put mkLit's default argument on a namespace
   forward declaration rather than its non-defining friend declaration.
   This declaration-only fix lets conforming GCC and Clang accept the header.

No SAT search or clause semantics were modified.
